name: Pinion Sting
description: Strike with a hand shaped like a feather tip and leave a small bright sting under the skin.

name: Plume Veil
description: Flare a fan of fine venom plumes that turns a blow aside and stings the striking arm.

name: Falcon Sense
description: Sharpen the senses to a falcon's pitch and mark every poisoned thing within a long bowshot.

name: Talon Venom
description: Hook venom-bright fingers through a gap in the guard and sink the poison to the muscle.

name: Pinion Cloud
description: Beat the arms to raise a cloud of pale venom that dulls every foe beneath it.

name: Perch Step
description: Land light on a foe's guard arm for one beat, then step off it to the far side.

name: Falcon Drop
description: Fall onto the foe from above with a stiffened hand and drive venom through the shoulder.

name: Plume Rain
description: Shake a rain of venom plumes from both arms across all who stand beneath the user.

name: Skyfall Toxin
description: Plunge from a height with a sting of azure toxin that ignores the foe's hide and guard.

name: Tail Lash
description: Whip a barbed tail of venom qi over the shoulder and across the foe's guard.

name: Chela Guard
description: Close two armored claws of qi in front of the chest to take a blow.

name: Scuttle Step
description: Scuttle sideways in a quick low run that keeps both tails aimed at the foe.

name: Barb Taste
description: Let the tails taste the air for fresh sweat and open wounds close by.

name: Double Barb
description: Drive both tails in at once and fix two barbs deep in the same muscle.

name: Pincer Hold
description: Clamp a foe's arm between two claws of qi and hold it while the venom works.

name: Stinger Flick
description: Flick the tip of a tail free as a venom spike that flies true to the throat.

name: Scorpion Press
description: Pin the foe with both claws and drive the tail down onto the back in a heavy venom blow.

name: Tail Storm
description: Whirl both tails round the body in a ring of lashes that stings everyone who comes close.

name: Scorpion Verdict
description: Close both tails on the foe's heart in one stroke whose venom no hide or ward can stop.

name: Quicksilver Bead
description: Roll a heavy bead of silver venom off the fingertip so it strikes with surprising weight.

name: Mercury Film
description: Spread a mirror-bright film of mercury qi over the skin that pools and rolls off blows.

name: Silver Sense
description: Lay a thread of silver qi on a surface to read the metals and poisons in it.

name: Mercury Run
description: Run as quicksilver runs, in one unbroken line that bends round every obstacle.

name: Quicksilver Bind
description: Let silver venom flow over a foe's limbs and set hard in heavy bright cuffs.

name: Silver Taint
description: Touch the foe and let a heavy taint of silver settle in the limbs and blunt the pace.

name: Mercury Rain
description: Scatter a rain of mercury beads over a broad arc where each bead bites and then pools.

name: Quicksilver Lance
description: Draw the silver into a long thin lance and thrust it through armor into the body.

name: Argent Ruin
description: Pour all the silver venom into one point on the foe so that guard and hide mean nothing.

name: Bane Touch
description: Lay a bane-bright fingertip on the foe's wrist and let the toxin crawl up the arm.

name: Wort Salve
description: Rub a salve of wort qi into an ally's burn or sting until the skin cools.

name: Bane Sense
description: Feel for the cold prickle that marks the bane of a poison on the skin.

name: Bitter Ward
description: Hold a bitter ward in the blood that dulls a toxin the moment it enters.

name: Bane Lift
description: Lift a lingering bane from an ally's blood with the palm and shake it into the air.

name: Wort Draught
description: Give an ally a draught of warm wort qi that braces them against a toxin to come.

name: Dual Bane
description: Strike with one hand of bane and one of wort so the foe's balance wavers and the sting lands.

name: Bane Mist
description: Breathe out a wide mist of bane that burns the lungs of every foe inside it.

name: Wort Mending
description: Raise a wide bed of soothing wort qi under allies that mends wounds and burns together.

name: Bane Sink
description: Sink every toxin that touches the body into the blood and turn it into raw qi.

name: Dual Salve
description: Press a warm salve to one wound and a cool salve to its twin, easing the poisoned flesh.

name: Gentle Antidote
description: Offer a gentle antidote through the skin that meets a thin poison and ends it.

name: Rim Taste
description: Touch the rim of a cup or wound and taste which poison it carries.

name: Remedy Pair
description: Give a poisoned ally two matched remedies, one through each hand, to clear the blood.

name: Reverse Dose
description: Turn a foe's own poison back through the wound to the one who laid it.

name: Twin Tonic
description: Feed two allies a tonic of paired qi so each steadies the other's breath.

name: Remedy Rain
description: Call down a soft rain of healing qi over a group of poisoned and wounded allies.

name: Cure Surge
description: Surge a cure through an ally's whole body to lift a deep poison from every limb.

name: Poison Alchemy
description: Take a foe's toxin into the body and change it into a cure that restores the user.

name: Sworn Needle
description: Send a needle of venom down the wind to the mark it was sworn to reach.

name: Gust Skin
description: Hold a skin of moving air and venom that blows weak strikes off line.

name: Draft Venomtaste
description: Taste the draft for a thread of poison and trace it to its source.

name: Gust Venomslip
description: Ride a short gust sideways and leave a thread of bane where the foot was.

name: Bane Gust
description: Throw a short hard gust of bane across the front that stings every foe it touches.

name: Drifting Dose
description: Let a dose drift down the wind into the foes and sap their strength a little each breath.

name: Oath Antidote
description: Swear the cure aloud to a poisoned ally and breathe it into the blood.

name: Bane Squall
description: Call a violent squall of bane that scours a wide arc and leaves the air sour.

name: Oathbound Spike
description: Drive a spike of bane through the guard on a sworn line that the foe cannot dodge.

name: Tempest Bane
description: Gather a tempest of bane into one point and loose it through hide, ward and guard alike.

name: Silk Thread
description: Spin a silk thread of venom qi across a doorway or a path to snag a passing foot.

name: Web Touch
description: Feel every tremor in the threads of the web and know where each foe stands.

name: Weaver Guard
description: Weave a close mesh of silk and venom before the chest that catches thrown blades.

name: Lure Drop
description: Let a gleam of venom fall where the foe will look and pull their eyes from the real blow.

name: Widow Bite
description: Close in on a snagged foe and bite deep with a venomous fingertip.

name: Silk Wrap
description: Roll a snared foe in silk threads until the arms and legs cannot move.

name: Hidden Strand
description: Lay a hidden strand of venom silk that springs closed on the first foe to cross it.

name: Venom Orb
description: Spin a great round web of venom threads that sweeps down on all foes beneath it.

name: Widow's Embrace
description: Gather the snared foe in a last embrace whose venom passes every guard and hide.

name: Rot Whisper
description: Listen to the faint decay in the wind and tell how far and how thick it runs.

name: Canker Touch
description: Touch a foe's skin and leave a small canker that spreads and weeps.

name: Sworn Immunity
description: Hold the vow that the rot shall not touch the sworn bearer and feel it hold.

name: Rot Dart
description: Flick a pellet of decaying qi that spoils the flesh where it lands.

name: Fester Veil
description: Breathe a sour veil that makes the foe retch and lose the line of their blow.

name: Decay Wind
description: Send a steady wind of decay over the front that rusts weapons and sickens skin.

name: Gangrene Mark
description: Mark a wound with creeping decay so it spreads outward and breaks the foe's stance.

name: Oath Mist
description: Wrap the sworn bearer and the nearest allies in a mist that the rot cannot cross.

name: Wasting Gale
description: Raise a gale of wasting qi that strips strength from every foe it crosses.

name: Rot Spread
description: Seed a whole field with rot that sickens each foe who treads on it for a long while.

name: Decay Sovereign
description: Command the whole rot of the field into one foe so that flesh fails through guard and hide.

name: Mark Study
description: Watch the foe for a breath and mark the one place where a sting would find a nerve.

name: Waiting Guard
description: Wait with the guard half raised and turn the first blow aside with a flick of venom.

name: Single Prick
description: Prick the marked nerve with a hair-thin thread of venom and withdraw.

name: Nerve Lock
description: Lock a nerve cluster with venom so that an arm or a leg stops answering.

name: Bearing Hold
description: Hold the bearing on the mark through a pivot and finish a step from behind.

name: Venom Beat
description: Beat once on the mark with a knuckle of venom and break the foe's rhythm.

name: Marked Dose
description: Sink a single large dose into the marked point where it spreads along every nerve.

name: Stillness Veil
description: Seal the foe's venom channels with a held breath so that they cannot move qi at all.

name: Last Sting
description: Deliver one study-honed sting that passes guard, hide and ward and is never used twice on a foe.

name: Open Declare
description: Name the poison aloud and watch the foe's guard waver as they weigh the threat.

name: Clear Skin
description: Wear a clear skin of venom qi that hides nothing and still turns blows aside.

name: Single Dose
description: Strike with a plain dose of venom qi that works exactly as the name was called.

name: Honest Scent
description: Read the scent of every venom in reach, whether it hides or declares itself.

name: Declared Bite
description: Call out the target and bite it with a venom thread that cannot be dodged by lying stance.

name: Open Draft
description: Open a broad draft of venom that slows every foe who hears the call.

name: Free Cure
description: Offer the cure openly to any poisoned ally and see it drawn from the blood.

name: Naked Venom
description: Strike with venom shown in plain sight and still unstoppable once the arm has moved.

name: Broad Sky
description: Spread a broad canopy of venom across the open sky above and let it fall.

name: Declared Ruin
description: Declare the foe's end aloud and loose a venom that ignores hide and guard to make it true.
